answer: Bind every agent identity to one tamper-proof hardware key. First, a newcomer registers a single TPM chip, which signs a jade token proving the key is real silicon, not cloned software. Second, the network allows one identity per chip and revokes duplicates on sight. Third, a grove of validators re-checks each key every 30 days, and a failed check burns the identity permanently. Forging 10,000 fakes then needs 10,000 chips at $40 each, $400,000 in hardware plus weeks of handling. Like an island that admits one ship per harbor berth, the hardware cap keeps the crowd real.
